about: Yi-Hsuan Rachel Lin stands as a seasoned senior associate, making her mark within the esteemed confines of the Law Offices of Justin J. Shrenger, A Professional Corporation, a renowned law firm nestled in the vibrant heart of Los Angeles, California. She focuses her practice on employment law, business litigation and civil litigation.

Guided by an unyielding commitment to justice and a profound understanding of the nuances that underpin the legal realm, Ms. Lin has emerged as an invaluable asset within her legal sphere. Drawing from her wealth of experience and comprehensive knowledge, she approaches each case with unwavering dedication, ensuring that every legal matter entrusted to her receives the attention to detail and zealous advocacy it rightfully deserves.

Ms. Lin has extensive experience representing clients in civil litigation matters, including cases involving business fraud, contractual disputes and more. She also has a wealth of experience representing employees in state and federal courts against commercial and public companies in situations involving discrimination, harassment and retaliation. She defends clients who have made claims of wrongdoing under the California Labor Code, the federal False Claims Act, and similar state laws as well.

After receiving her bachelor’s degree in law from the National Taipei University, Ms. Lin went on to pursue her master’s degree in international law and legal studies from the Case Western Reserve University School of Law. She decided to go to law school after working as a litigation law clerk in a civil litigation law firm for seven years.

In 2015, Ms. Lin graduated summa cum laude from Southwestern Law School with a Juris Doctor degree. She did her internships with the Honorable Goodwin Liu of the California Supreme Court, with the Honorable Dean Pregerson of the California Central District Court, and with the ACLU of Southern California.

Ms. Lin has volunteered with the Workers’ Rights Clinic of the Neighborhood Legal Services of Los Angeles County, Bet Tzedek Legal Services, and the Pro Bono Legal Aid Clinic of the Southern California Chinese Lawyers Association. She is licensed to practice in California and New York and before the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California. She is an active member of the Southern California Chinese Lawyers Association.
